svg.text: Logical view: components and data flows
Numbers match the flows listed below. Data plane v2 is what an org on cells uses; v1 orgs keep today's path.
/v1 sessions, messages, SSE, cancel, approvals, webhooks, search API
history segments + messages-only companions, cell snapshots
session files, memories, full model prompts
Parquet (structured search) and Tantivy (text search) segments
Manage: UI and CLI call the management API (agents, secrets, orgs)
Sign in; get a signed org token (carries the org, verified at the edge)
Sessions: one API URL; the edge router sends them to the session's cell
Config: agent definitions and tenant policy, broadcast to all cells
Usage, cost and session summaries roll up asynchronously
Gateway admits, reads and streams from the session's cell
Cell assigns a claim; executor appends events under it
All outbound traffic of executors and sandboxes goes through egress
Executor unwraps the org's data key to decrypt secrets in memory
Cells write history, snapshots and indexes; executors write files and prompts
Trace and search queries: catalog from cells, data from S3
Admin: enable, suspend, export or delete an org (control plane to data plane)
